facts.text: You've got a lab in your head and no snacks in your pockets? Kid, I'll fix that.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Harley's words, but he never says it. On the quote page Harley's lines are about his dad and 'Why don't you just build something?'. The 'kid' line is Tony talking to Harley, not the other way round.

fix_note.text: Why don't you just build something?

facts.why: A write-up of the film says Tony remotely puts an Iron Man suit on Pepper during an attack, and she wears it again at the climax.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Tony is stranded in the snow in Tennessee.
facts.why: The unfinished suit flies Tony to rural Tennessee and runs out of power, so he is stuck there. Fits.

vibe.verdict: The Tennessee garage truck suits the middle of the film, but the menu skips the funniest and most food related scenes.
